notes.title: Wax Heads Demo: Linux Version OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982268/d944025613f6b7a19d560b4503f0863905d6cbe5.png[/img]
Hello vinyl spinners and aspiring Wax Heads! 

Thank you so much for all of your love and support for our announcement for Wax Heads. <3

We are beyond thrilled to see how many people have wishlisted and played the demo already!

And it is with great happiness we can now announce [b]the demo is available for Linux users!!![/b]

AND also that we have a new patch with some bug fixes and quality of life updates (which are listed below). 

We have so many exciting plans and updates to share with you as we continue to develop and we cannot wait to show them!! 

(Like the amazing physical stand Rothio has put together for Guadalindie this week (if you're in Málaga make sure to pop by!))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982268/2aa8d4abf58e1c6822d0d08cee8fe3281c62f950.png[/img]
In the mean time, thank you so much for checking out the demo and be sure to look out for further repeater records news!

Keep on spinning everyone.

Much love,

Patattie Games 
(Murray & Rothio)

(Patch Notes:)

FIXED:
Fixed a bug that prevented Diggy Doggo character movement after completing the Demo
Fixed a bug where the language would change automatically after intro from Spanish to English
Fixed a few Spanish localization misspells
Fixed overflow of text in some record descriptions

CHANGES THANKS TO YOUR AMAZING FEEDBACK ❤️
Improved visuals in Suffering Jukebox
Improved intractability hints in phonogram reactions
Making phone notification more noticeable (hehe) with an idle animation
Creating a visual hint when records are added using the dog figurine
